justification: Inspected core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/oned/{OneDReader.java,UPCEANReader.java,OneDimensionalCodeWriter.java,UPCEANWriter.java,MultiFormatOneDReader.java,MultiFormatUPCEANReader.java} and the direct package contents. The package is sizable (28 production classes, 5,507 LOC), but responsibilities are split across barcode-specific readers/writers (Code39, Code93, Code128, ITF, CodaBar, EAN/UPC) plus thin shared base classes and dispatchers; related RSS logic is already separated into com.google.zxing.oned.rss and com.google.zxing.oned.rss.expanded, so the package is broad but not a single centralized God Component.
